heading_4: How A3S makes your site accessible and keeps it that way
paragraph_5: A3S brings your website into conformance with WCAG and keeps it there. Here is what that involves, from the first assessment to ongoing monitoring.
paragraph_7: Most organizations we work with already have some accessibility work in place, such as fixes made over time, an accessibility plugin or an existing ACR. A3S is the missing piece: we validate what you already have, close the gaps and keep it documented.
paragraph_9: If you're not sure of the answers, that's where A3S comes in.
paragraph_11: We start by reviewing your site and agreeing on what is in scope. Certified specialists then manually test it with assistive technology, and we fix the issues we find, most serious first. Once every fix has been retested, we document your site's conformance in an ACR. From then on, we monitor your site every month so it stays that way.
text_13: See the full process on a3s.app
paragraph_16: An ACR reflects your site on the date it was tested. New pages, documents and system updates can introduce new issues, so conformance has to be maintained.
paragraph_18: Some issues sit in systems managed by others, such as your CMS provider. We handle that communication for you.
paragraph_20: We keep track of everything. Every issue, fix and retest is documented in one clear, organized record that you can share with anyone who asks.
